items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: That's the way Trapani used to do it, watch me.

ctx.x: It's a bass drum on the left.

On the left, always take your bass drum on your left beat. If your band, if the snare drum is this diadon slow, if he's giving you the cadence, and if you're getting ready to play a funeral march, he just bring his drum down to a slow tempo or into a light roll, and the bass drum player might holler, watch me. That's the way Trapani used to do it, watch me. And everybody be waiting, and he just take the bass drum and hit three slow beats, not too far apart, you understand? And then after that third beat, them…
That's for the dirge, for the dirges, or are they...
